## Browse this palette

This entry opens a palette folder; it is not an executable dataflow function.

| Entry | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [1D ANOVA](../../math/statistics/anova/anova_1d.md) | Zero-based group indices; real unbalanced one-factor calculation. No padding with invented zero observations. |
| [2D ANOVA](../../math/statistics/anova/anova_2d.md) | Signed levels: positive fixed, negative random. Balanced cells, actual A/B/AB effects. Without replication fixed additive only; mixed denominator selection is actual. Signed levels identify fixed/random factors. Balanced replicated factors use the corresponding interaction denominator; unreplicated fixed models are additive. |
| [3D ANOVA](../../math/statistics/anova/anova_3d.md) | Three-factor decomposition including all interactions. Signed levels fixed/random. GS mixed-model denominator projection and -1 unavailable tests are explicit, not NI-certified Satterthwaite. GS exact-denominator profile: no random factor outside effect uses MSE; one outside uses the union interaction; two outside report F/p=-1 instead of inventing a denominator. |
